fields.label: Device ID
fields.description: The machine this is for, as its punches name it in `Employee Checkin.device_id`. A bridge runs only the commands for machines in its own config.toml.

fields.label: Action
fields.options:
Check User
Add User
List Users
fields.description: What the bridge will do at the machine. The list is closed on the server and again in the bridge: there is no action here that clears the punch log, wipes the machine or switches it off.

fields.label: Machine Number
fields.description: The number the machine calls this person, which is `Employee.attendance_device_id`. Digits only. Not needed by List Users.

fields.label: Name on Machine
fields.description: What the machine will show beside the number. Cut to 24 characters, because the machine cuts it anyway and silently.

fields.label: Employee
fields.description: Who this is about, when it was raised from a person's record. The machine is told a number and never a name it could match.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Pending until a bridge picks it up. Nothing ever goes back to Pending: a finished command sent round again would add a second user, or answer a question somebody has already acted on.

fields.label: Found on Machine
fields.description: Check User's answer, as a tick: whether the machine holds that number.

fields.label: Attempts
fields.description: How many times a bridge has picked this up. More than one means a machine that would not answer, not a command run twice.

fields.label: Result
fields.description: The machine's answer in words, or the reason it could not be reached. Written by the bridge.

fields.label: Picked Up At
fields.description: When a bridge claimed it. A command still Pending minutes later means no bridge is running for that machine.
